title: Triptolide is a Promising Therapeutic Approach in Treating Thyroid Cancer Based on in silico and in vitro Experiment.
authors: Wang, Fang; An, Shu-Jing; Yin, Yirong; Li, Juan-Juan; Sun, Chun-Hui; Lan, Jie; Zhao, Wen-Juan; Li, Cheng-Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雷公藤甲素治疗甲状腺癌的靶点与机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Thyroid cancer is a familiar kind of cancer. Natural products are promising therapeutic approaches in treating thyroid cancer. Triptolide is a diterpenoid epoxide extracted from Tripterygium wilfordii. The mechanism of triptolide in the treatment of thyroid cancer has not been investigated clearly. METHODS: We evaluated triptolide targets and thyroid cancer targets with related databases. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks of the triptolide targets and thyroid cancer targets were constructed with Cytoscape software. Gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses of the core PPI network were obtained. Molecular docking analysis was used to evaluated the binding of triptolide with core targets. Furthermore, apoptosis assays, real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and Western blotting were used to evaluate the anticancer functions of triptolide. RESULTS: Triptolide had 34 targets, and thyroid cancer had 210 targets. The core PPI network of merged PPI networks had 164 nodes and 4513 edges. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses showed that triptolide were related to the cell cycle, apoptosis, and inflammatory signaling pathways. Molecular docking analysis showed that triptolide directly reacted with four core targets: cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1A (CDKN1A), c-JUN, RELA, and tumor protein p53 (TP53). CB-Dock analysis indicated that triptolide could stably bind to core targets. Triptolide inhibited the growth but induced apoptosis of thyroid cancer cells. Triptolide increased the mRNA expression of CDKN1A and TP53 but reduced the mRNA expression of c-JUN and RELA, as shown by RT-PCR. Triptolide increased the protein levels of CDKN1A and phospho-p53 but reduced those of phospho-c-JUN and phospho-NF-kappaB p65, as shown by Western blotting. DISCUSSION: We considered that triptolide could treat thyroid cancer by inhibiting cell proliferation, inducing apoptosis and inhibiting inflammatory pathways such as the NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways. CDKN1A, c-JUN, RELA, and TP53 were involved in the antithyroid cancer mechanism of triptolide.
abstract_zh: 引言：甲状腺癌是一种常见的癌症类型。天然产物是治疗甲状腺癌的有前景的治疗方法。雷公藤甲素（triptolide）是从雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii）中提取的一种二萜环氧化物。雷公藤甲素治疗甲状腺癌的机制尚未被明确研究。方法：我们利用相关数据库评估了雷公藤甲素的靶点和甲状腺癌的靶点。使用Cytoscape软件构建了雷公藤甲素靶点和甲状腺癌靶点的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。获得了核心PPI网络的基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析。使用分子对接分析评估雷公藤甲素与核心靶点的结合。此外，使用细胞凋亡检测、实时聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）和蛋白质印迹法评估雷公藤甲素的抗癌功能。结果：雷公藤甲素具有34个靶点，甲状腺癌具有210个靶点。合并PPI网络的核心PPI网络包含164个节点和4513条边。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，雷公藤甲素与细胞周期、细胞凋亡和炎症信号通路相关。分子对接分析显示，雷公藤甲素直接与四个核心靶点反应：细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂1A（CDKN1A）、c-JUN、RELA和肿瘤蛋白p53（TP53）。CB-Dock分析表明，雷公藤甲素能稳定结合核心靶点。雷公藤甲素抑制甲状腺癌细胞的生长，但诱导其凋亡。RT-PCR显示，雷公藤甲素增加了CDKN1A和TP53的mRNA表达，但降低了c-JUN和RELA的mRNA表达。蛋白质印迹法显示，雷公藤甲素增加了CDKN1A和磷酸化p53的蛋白水平，但降低了磷酸化c-JUN和磷酸化NF-kappaB p65的水平。讨论：我们认为雷公藤甲素通过抑制细胞增殖、诱导细胞凋亡以及抑制NF-kappaB和MAPK等炎症信号通路来治疗甲状腺癌。CDKN1A、c-JUN、RELA和TP53参与了雷公藤甲素的抗甲状腺癌机制。
